entries.title: A kept merge sticks to the version you approved
entries.body: After a refusal, the app merges only the version on the card you clicked, or one its crewmate shows only brought it up to date. It waits for GitHub's own rules, such as a required review, and carries on after a restart without merging twice.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new on screen: the app merges the version you approved.
